completeInfoAlertTitle: Managing User Identity in Incident Reporting
completeInfoAlertMessage: When you make edits or submit new incidents those actions will be associated with your user account and the name you enter here. If you would like to remain anonymous at any point you can open the website in an anonymous browser session
apiTokenIntro: This token identifies your account to the API in place of the browser session: send it in the Authorization header as a Bearer token. Treat it like a password.
